description: Cloud storage tiers decomposed. S3 storage classes + lifecycle, EBS volume types, EFS performance modes, Glacier retrieval, cross-region replication, S3 Object Lock, request pricing optimisation.

sub_mechanisms.name: S3_Standard_class
sub_mechanisms.definition: Default class. 99.99% availability. Low latency. Most expensive per GB ($0.023).
sub_mechanisms.why: Active data. Default until proven otherwise. Lifecycle to cheaper after period.

sub_mechanisms.name: S3_IA_one_zone
sub_mechanisms.definition: Infrequent Access. ~50% cheaper than Standard. Per-GB retrieval charge.
sub_mechanisms.why: Backup, less-accessed data. One-Zone IA: cheaper still, single AZ (no AZ failure tolerance).

sub_mechanisms.name: S3_Glacier_Instant
sub_mechanisms.definition: Archive tier with millisecond retrieval. Cheap per GB; per-GB retrieval.
sub_mechanisms.why: Compliance retention with occasional read. Modern alternative to legacy Glacier for use cases needing fast access.

sub_mechanisms.name: S3_Glacier_Flexible
sub_mechanisms.why: Long-term archives with rare access. Cost: pay for retrieval (free up to 10 GB/mo). 90-day minimum storage.

sub_mechanisms.name: S3_Deep_Archive
sub_mechanisms.why: Compliance archive: regulatory data kept years. Cheapest known storage. Glacier vault lock for WORM.

sub_mechanisms.name: S3_Intelligent_Tiering
sub_mechanisms.definition: Auto-move between Frequent + Infrequent + Archive based on access pattern. Small monitoring fee.
sub_mechanisms.why: Set-and-forget cost optimisation. Unknown access patterns. Modern default for general workloads.

sub_mechanisms.name: S3_lifecycle_rules
sub_mechanisms.definition: Transition objects between classes based on age. Or expire (delete).
sub_mechanisms.why: Automated cost optimisation. 'Standard → IA after 30d → Glacier after 90d → expire after 7 years'. Standard FinOps pattern.

sub_mechanisms.name: EBS_gp3_vs_io2
sub_mechanisms.definition: gp3: $0.08/GB, provisioned IOPS independent. io2: $0.125/GB + IOPS, max 256K IOPS, multi-attach.
sub_mechanisms.why: gp3 default for most workloads. io2 for critical databases needing > 16K IOPS or multi-attach. gp2 deprecated.

sub_mechanisms.name: EBS_snapshot_incremental
sub_mechanisms.definition: First snapshot full; subsequent incremental. Stored in S3 (managed).
sub_mechanisms.why: Cheap backup. Restore: instant attach with lazy load. Cross-region copy. Standard EBS backup pattern.

sub_mechanisms.name: EFS_general_vs_max_IO
sub_mechanisms.definition: General: lower latency. MaxIO: higher throughput, higher latency.
sub_mechanisms.why: Choose by workload. Most: General. Big data: MaxIO. EFS Standard vs IA tier for cost.

sub_mechanisms.name: S3_cross_region_replication
sub_mechanisms.definition: Async replicate objects to bucket in different region. Versioning required.
sub_mechanisms.why: DR. Compliance (data sovereignty). Cost: storage + cross-region transfer. Per-object delete replication explicit.

sub_mechanisms.name: S3_Object_Lock_WORM
sub_mechanisms.definition: Write Once Read Many. Governance (override) or Compliance (immutable) mode.
sub_mechanisms.why: Regulatory compliance. Cannot delete or modify for retention period. Used for legal hold, audit logs.

derivation_rules.name: Intelligent_Tiering_optimal_for_unknown_patterns
derivation_rules.why: Auto-moves based on actual access. Manual: best guess on access pattern, often wrong. Small monitoring fee but typically nets savings.

derivation_rules.name: Deep_Archive_for_compliance_retention
if: data must be retained per regulation but rarely accessed
derivation_rules.why: $0.00099/GB vs $0.023 Standard = 23x cheaper. Acceptable: 12h retrieval for rare regulatory access. Standard for healthcare, finance retention.

derivation_rules.name: gp3_default_io2_for_critical_dbs
then: gp3 is the default; io2 only for high-IOPS critical DBs
derivation_rules.why: gp3 supports 16K IOPS, multi-AZ snapshots. io2: 256K IOPS, multi-attach, more expensive. Most workloads fit gp3.

derivation_rules.name: lifecycle_rules_save_dramatically
then: lifecycle to Glacier saves 95%+ on storage cost
derivation_rules.why: Standard $0.023/GB → Deep Archive $0.001/GB. Setting one lifecycle rule reduces cost 95%. Major FinOps lever.

derivation_rules.name: Object_Lock_for_regulatory_immutability
derivation_rules.why: Compliance mode: cannot delete or modify, even by root. Satisfies SEC 17a-4, GDPR retention. Standard for regulated industries.
